name: Mysore Masala Dosa
instructions: 1. Soak rice, urad dal, and fenugreek seeds for 6 hours and grind into a smooth batter; ferment overnight.
2. Prepare red chutney by grinding soaked Byadgi chilies with garlic and salt.
3. Make the potato filling by sautéing mustard seeds, curry leaves, onions, green chilies, and boiled potatoes with turmeric.
4. Heat a tawa, pour a ladle of batter, and spread it into a thin circular dosa.
5. Spread a spoonful of the red chutney over the dosa base.
6. Place a portion of potato filling in the center, drizzle with ghee, and fold the dosa once crispy.
description: Originating from the royal city of Mysore, this dish is a culinary icon of Karnataka. It is distinguished from a standard masala dosa by the iconic spicy, vibrant red garlic-chili chutney spread inside, offering a perfect balance of heat, crunch, and comfort.
